benchmark.name: tau-bench-synthetic cloud generated
benchmark.description: Cloud-LLM generated workflows from selected tau-bench synthetic samples.
assumptions: Cloud generation selects high-level chain/tool steps.
MOBench expands chain steps into primitive executable tools using tau-bench ground-truth action arguments.
Deployment and execution consume only normal wfgen.v1 tool/LLM nodes, never chain nodes.
